sources.supports: Pinned requirements can include top-level and transitive dependencies; hashes add artifact checking; compiled wheelhouses may be OS/architecture-specific.
In pip hash-checking mode requirements and dependencies must all be pinned and hashed.
The pylock.toml format specifies dependencies to enable reproducible installation; a format specification does not imply universal installer support.
Wheel format and installer compatibility are defined by tags/installer checks; supports the platform-compatibility assessment when read with pip's wheelhouse portability warning.
